# relay_ip_access_list (Data Source)

Reads one entry of a workspace's IP access list, by ID or by CIDR.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relay_ip_access_list" "office" {
  workspace_id = data.relay_workspace.prod.id
  cidr         = "203.0.113.0/24"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace to look in.

### Optional

- `cidr` (String) Network, as the API stores it.
- `id` (String) Entry ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `created_by` (String) Principal that added the entry.
- `description` (String) Free-text label.
